criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Issues
categories.definition: Queries related to problems with card usage, activation, or delivery.

categories.name: Transfer Issues
categories.definition: Queries about problems with money transfers, including pending or declined transfers.

categories.name: Top-Up Issues
categories.definition: Queries regarding problems with topping up accounts, including pending or failed top-ups.

categories.name: ATM Issues
categories.definition: Queries related to ATM transactions, including incorrect cash amounts or card retention.

categories.name: Fees and Charges
categories.definition: Queries about unexpected fees or charges on accounts or transactions.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Queries related to managing account details, including opening, closing, or modifying accounts.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Queries about identity verification processes and requirements.

categories.name: Currency Exchange
categories.definition: Queries about currency exchange rates and supported currencies.

categories.name: Fraud and Security
categories.definition: Queries related to suspected fraud or unauthorized use of accounts or cards.

categories.name: Payment Issues
categories.definition: Queries about declined payments or issues with specific payment methods.

categories.name: PIN Issues
categories.definition: Queries related to problems with card PINs, including unlocking or changing PINs.

categories.name: Virtual and Disposable Cards
categories.definition: Queries about virtual or disposable card usage and limits.

categories.name: Delivery and Shipping
categories.definition: Queries about the delivery status or tracking of cards or other banking materials.

categories.name: General Information
categories.definition: Queries seeking general information about banking services, policies, or procedures.
